question: What appearance and effect are attributed to the golden-hued form?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold.
It is a cause of agitation of cities and similar effects.
Appearance and function are linked in this description.
inference: The molten-gold-hued form causes the agitation of cities and related effects.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of agitating cities and the like.
